messages:
pat: Alert from log-shipper: filebeat indexed a log line containing a full KMS resource path and a truncated ciphertext header. not plaintext but sensitive.

ivy: paste the exact line and which service emitted it?

pat: redacted line: 
WARN backup-agent: unwrap failed for projects/payments-1/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/backup-transit: ciphertext=Gx9a...qZ

mike: that looks like the backup-agent. immediate steps: 1) snapshot audit logs for KMS/IAM/GCS, 2) remove decrypt role from backup SA in staging, 3) trigger KMS rotation, 4) list affected objects and owners.

sec-automation: Creating audit export job -> export-id=exp-4881239999.

oncall: Exporting 48h of Cloud Audit logs to gs://sec-hold/4881239999/; will DM link when done.

ivy: pat 1; grep the backup bucket metadata for objects with that ciphertext header. also check partner webhook logs.

pat: found 7 objects under gs://backups/staging/2026-03-24/ whose metadata references the old header. partner calls were only status pings, no blob transfers.

mike: applying RBAC change now (staging):
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding payments-1 \
  --member=serviceAccount:backup-agent@payments-1.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter

mike: RBAC removal applied (terraform diff: -1 binding).

vault-bot: Transit rotation requested: projects/payments-1/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/backup-transit. request=rot-4881.

vault-bot: Rotation complete. new primary version=5. audit_log=gs://sec-hold/4881239999/rotation.log

ivy: owners notified with rewrap instructions and a 48h SLA. sample rewrap script attached in the ticket.

pat: opening ticket INC-2026-0401-05 (sev3) to track. attaching audit export path when oncall posts it.

oncall: export complete -> gs://sec-hold/4881239999/audit-export.tar.gz (attached to incident).

mike: opened PR to redact KMS resource names in backup-agent logs; change will log masked ids only. unit tests added.

ivy: also adding a temporary alert for 72h that scans logs for KMS pattern regex and pages on hits.

sec-automation: Alert rule created and will expire in 72h.

pat: partner confirmed no downloads, owners have begun rewraps.

mike: after rewrap window we'll rotate again and restore least-privileged roles. schedule postmortem 30m tomorrow.

ivy: summary: detection -> RBAC revoke -> audit snapshot -> KMS rotation -> owner rewrap -> logging scrub -> alerting -> postmortem. incident INC-2026-0401-05 tracking. :white_check_mark:
